authority: RFC-EDGE-008 continues the direction WP-EDGE-07's measured cost barrier pointed at: hourly books need to capture 58-86 % of the open-to-open move to pay a 23.79 bps round trip (closed by arithmetic), a daily clock needs 11-16 % (a strategy problem).

bootstrap.why_blocks: trades inside a window are not independent; the serial-dependence reading states that rather than assuming it away

consequences_fixed_in_advance: a book that fails the gross screen (C0) is not read on the cross-section at all: its holdout rows are absent, not zero
a REJECT is reported with its numbers and the family is not tuned and re-run on the same window
an INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE is reported as no result, never as a pass
no parameter, stop, target, filter or cooldown is changed after seeing a reading
nothing here promotes, sizes or executes anything: promotion stays NONE and order_sent stays false for every arm

costs.note: the plane is a venue-level model: it does not carry a per-symbol spread or book depth, so the cross-section's thinner names are covered by the ADVERSE scenario rather than by a claim the data cannot support

F1.statement: ACTIVE only: trades/day across the universe >= 3.0

F2.statement: QUALITY only: trades/day across the universe >= 0.05 (about one trade per asset every twenty days), reported and decisive as a floor on viability

P5.statement: largest single trade <= 50% of the net

P6.statement: at least one positive market context

R1.statement: net still > 0 with the largest winner removed

R2.statement: net > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 equal time blocks

S1.statement: DEV gross > 0 on the cross-section: the entry, not the exit, carries it

edge06_trend_fixed.already: WP-EDGE-06's fixed 3xATR target, REJECT on WP-EDGE-07's unread window

edge07_active_thrust.already: WP-EDGE-07's ACTIVE thrust book, REJECT_NO_GROSS_EDGE on the known universe

edge_trend_01_4h.already: the frozen WP-EDGE-01 ruleset: 4h trend with a 3xATR trailing exit

gross_screen.consequence: a book that fails C0 gets REJECT_NO_GROSS_EDGE and is NOT read on the cross-section; its holdout rows are absent, not zero
gross_screen.statement: gross expectancy > 0 on the known universe's DEV window

multiplicity.note: every arm is reported; no book is re-parameterised after seeing a result, and a book that fails the gross screen is not read on the cross-section at all

registered_before_reading: this file is committed before any bar of the cross-section is aggregated or measured; the raw shards are fetched from public Binance REST, and a download is not a reading — no figure of this universe existed anywhere when this file was written
title: Alpha on an unread cross-section, with ACTIVE and QUALITY kept apart

tracks.ACTIVE: a one-hour entry clock with multi-day holds, aiming at three trades a day across the universe; net expectancy comes before frequency and nothing is forced
tracks.CURRENT: books this project already registered and measured, carried as the baseline; they change no verdict
tracks.QUALITY: a daily clock, holds of days to weeks, few trades with a large objective each; screened on gross expectancy and on a frequency floor, never on frequency alone

universe.claim: no committed artefact of this repository has been measured on these symbols: their history, and the whole of it, is the evidence this work package reads once

verdicts.ADMIT_PAPER: every decisive criterion passes on the cross-section's OOS window: admission to paper only; no live trading, no capital, no promotion beyond a paper lane, and the risk-manager's and the release gate's own conditions still apply
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: the measurement cannot support a conclusion (unpowered sample with the rest non-negative, one trade carrying the net, or coverage below the declared floor)
verdicts.REJECT: a decisive criterion failed with power on the cross-section; the family is reported with its numbers and is not tuned and re-run on the same window
verdicts.REJECT_NO_GROSS_EDGE: the book lost money before any fee on the known universe, so the cross-section was not read with it

what_this_cannot_say: the cross-section is six symbols: a transfer test across six names is evidence about those names, not a proof that a book generalises to every market
the cost plane is venue-level; a per-symbol spread is not modelled and the ADVERSE scenario is the only sensitivity that speaks to it
the decisive window's sample size is what the book's own frequency makes it; a book that trades twice a year cannot be powered by 1.8 years of six symbols
